server.name: io.github.cmendezs/mcp-ksef-pl
server.description: Polish e-invoicing MCP: KSeF API v2, FA(3)/FA(2) XML, Peppol BIS 3.0, NIP/REGON validation.

environmentVariables.description: KSeF v2 AccessToken obtained via the challenge/redeem auth flow. Required for submit_invoice_to_ksef.
environmentVariables.name: KSEF_SESSION_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: NIP (Polish tax identifier, 10 digits) of the entity submitting invoices.
environmentVariables.name: KSEF_NIP

environmentVariables.description: Target KSeF environment: 'production' or 'test' (default: test).
environmentVariables.name: KSEF_ENVIRONMENT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds (default: 30).
environmentVariables.name: KSEF_TIMEOUT
